node_definition.done_when: Done when tests/test_every_review_record_write_moves_the_index.py, on a temporary crew home, runs each entry point named above against one indexed run's record. For each one it asserts that store_index_run_digest for that run changes and that store_index_version advances. A second test replaces record_written with a function that does nothing, runs the same entry points, and asserts that every one of the first test's checks now fails. The foreign-write test in tests/test_the_review_store_is_indexed_by_its_writers.py reads the version after the rebuild, then asserts that the foreign run appears in store_index_changed_runs since that version. It fails when reconcile_foreign_write is replaced by a function returning 0. The test files importing the changed modules add no failure against base in matched arms run as an all_debug partition job, submitted with env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch and never on the fleet node. Each arm's log sits under the run directory, opens with its revision and literal command, and ends in EXIT=. ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the staged paths.
